sources.evidence: Baekjoon Online Judge category page titled 'Al-Khawarizmi National Programming Contest 2013', filed under ACM-ICPC Regionals > Asia > Malaysia > Malaysia National Programming Contest, listing problems A to J.

malaysia-national-2014.notes: Source 3 says 61 teams, source 1 lists 60 (a team may be missing from the standings). Source 3 was filed as rankings but only gives two teams' places, so I corrected it to report. Source 3's date line reads 01 October 2014; page 'last modified 05/01/2026'.

sources.evidence: Table of 60 ranked teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation under the heading 'ACM ICPC Malaysia al-Khawarizmi National Programming Contest 2014', with no per-problem columns.
News item of a Malaysian university's faculty of informatics, in Malay, giving only the placings of its own two teams (21 of 61 and 25 of 61), not an order of teams.

malaysia-national-2016.notes: Source 1: the scoreboard, program, system configuration and problem set files are linked but not in the crawl (only 14 files saved, no images or style sheet), so results and statements are missing from our copy. The home page's side menu also links 2014 KL regional files that are not in the copy.

sources.evidence: Site of the Kulliyyah of ICT, International Islamic University Malaysia, titled 'ACM ICPC Malaysia al-Khawarizmi National Programming Contest 2016', with Date '7 Oct & 8 Oct 2016' and pages for registration, rules, program, scoreboard and a fact sheet.

Baekjoon Online Judge category 'Al-Khawarizmi National Programming Contest 2016' under ICPC Regionals > Asia Pacific > Malaysia, listing problems A to J (numbers 14533 to 14542) with the titles the catalogue gives.

malaysia-national-2018.notes: Scoreboard PDF is an image; team count could not be established. Editorial slide header says 2013 although the cover says May 2018. Source 4 and 6 have names of 2014 files.

sources.evidence: Site titled 'ACM ICPC Malaysia al-Khawarizmi National Programming Contest 2018' with contest details dated 11th & 12th May 2018 at International Islamic University Malaysia.
One-page PDF headed 'Scoreboard Al-Khawarizmi National Programming Contest 2018' with columns rank, team, score and problems A to J (read by OCR from an image).
Baekjoon category page titled 'Al-Khawarizmi National Programming Contest 2018' with 10 problems A-J, filed under ICPC Regionals, Asia Pacific, Malaysia.
Six-page PDF 'Problem Set Analysis' dated 11th-12th May 2018 listing problems A-J with approaches.

malaysia-national-2019.notes: Source 1 also holds the November 2019 ICPC Asia Kuala Lumpur Regional subsite (a different contest); the national site pages are of this edition. Source 3 dashboard shows a 2026 user clarification posted in the gym.

sources.evidence: Home page 'ICPC Malaysia al-Khawarizmi National Programming Contest 2019' states 26th & 27th April 2019 at International Islamic University Malaysia, Kuala Lumpur.
DOMjudge page headed 'Scoreboard Al-Khawarizmi National Programming Contest 2019 - Final Result 27 April 2019' with 36 team rows and columns a to k.
Codeforces gym dashboard '2019 ICPC Malaysia National' listing problems A-K matching the known problem names.
